sections.subhead: Moving Your Site Without Losing Traffic, Rankings, or Data

body.html: WordPress Migration Services in Kochi by Teknoppy moves your WordPress site to a new host or domain, and rebuilds Wix, Squarespace or Shopify sites on WordPress from our Kochi studio. Every move is planned for minimal downtime, with a full backup and rollback plan for every project. Most host moves take 2–4 days.

Businesses across Kochi and Kerala usually need this for one of a few reasons — a hosting renewal that has become too expensive, a developer relationship that is ending, or outgrowing a website builder that cannot scale. Our migration work ensures the transition is seamless for your visitors and safe for your search rankings.

items.title: WordPress Site Migration
items.html: Our WordPress site migration Kochi process covers a full transfer of files, database, plugins, and configuration from the old environment to the new one, verified against the original before the switch goes live.

items.title: Hosting Migration
items.html: A WordPress hosting migration service moves your site to a new host without the downtime that comes from doing it manually — DNS, SSL certificates, and email routing are all planned in advance, not fixed after something breaks.

items.title: Domain Migration
items.html: WordPress domain migration Kochi work includes a full URL redirect map, so search engines and existing links follow the site to its new address instead of returning dead pages.

items.title: Platform-to-WordPress Migration
items.html: If you're not already on WordPress, our team handles website migrations to WordPress from builders like Wix, Squarespace, or Shopify — rebuilding the content and structure natively. For online stores, see our Ecommerce Migration services.

sections.h2: How We Protect Your Rankings and Email

items.title: 301 Redirect Mapping
items.text: Every indexed URL is matched to its new address page-by-page so existing Google rankings and backlinks are preserved without dead 404 links.

items.title: Full Backup & Rollback Plan
items.text: Before changing DNS or touching production, complete backups of all files and databases are taken, with a verified rollback procedure in place.

items.title: Search Console Address Change
items.text: For domain migrations, we initiate the Google Search Console Change of Address tool and verify sitemaps to accelerate search indexing.

items.title: DNS & MX Record Preservation
items.text: Mail exchange (MX), SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records are carefully separated from web DNS so your business email never suffers interruptions.

items.title: Pre-Migration Audit
items.text: We map every plugin, page, form, and integration on the current site so nothing gets missed during the move.

items.title: Staging Environment Setup
items.text: The site is rebuilt on a staging copy of the new host first, so the live site stays untouched until everything is verified.

items.title: Data & Database Transfer
items.text: Our WordPress data migration Kochi process moves content, media, and database tables with a checksum comparison against the original.

items.title: DNS & Redirect Cutover
items.text: Timed for low-traffic hours, with a full WordPress migration checklist followed step by step to catch anything that could break during the switch.

items.title: Post-Migration Verification
items.text: Every page, form, and integration is re-tested on the live site immediately after cutover, not left to be discovered broken later.

If you're not migrating an existing WordPress site but building fresh functionality instead, see our Custom WordPress Development Kochi page. If your site just needs to load faster on its current host, our WordPress Speed Optimization page covers that separately.

Businesses considering WordPress Migration Services Kochi work usually already know which of these situations applies to them, which is why we start every project with a short scoping call rather than a blind quote.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — WordPress Migration Services Kochi

items.q: What does our WordPress migration service include?
items.a: It includes a pre-migration audit, staging setup, database and file transfer, DNS and 301 redirect cutover, and post-migration testing — everything needed to move a site without losing data, rankings, or functionality.

items.q: Can you move my website to WordPress from Wix, Squarespace or Shopify?
items.a: Yes. We rebuild the site natively on WordPress rather than relying on an automated export. Content, images, blog posts and page structures are moved across cleanly so you gain full control of your website.

items.q: Will migration affect my Google rankings?
items.a: A well-run migration should not cause lasting ranking loss. Some movement for a few weeks is normal while Google re-crawls the new URLs. We keep it small with a page-by-page 301 redirect map and Search Console monitoring.

items.q: Do you offer emergency migration support?
items.a: Yes. Emergency migration support is available if your current host is failing, your site is down, or you need to move on short notice with minimal disruption.

items.q: How long does a typical migration take?
items.a: Most standard host-to-host moves are completed within 2 to 4 days, including staging verification and cutover. Platform rebuilds (Wix or Shopify to WordPress) typically take 1 to 3 weeks depending on page count.

items.q: How much does WordPress migration cost in Kochi?
items.a: A standard WordPress host or domain migration starts from Rs. 15,000. Rebuilding from platforms like Wix or Squarespace onto WordPress ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 depending on content volume and custom features.
